stops.title: Ligands, Werner's theory & IUPAC nomenclature
stops.inShort: EDTA⁴⁻ is a hexadentate ligand (6 donor atoms: 2 N, 4 O). Werner's theory: primary valency (ionizable, oxidation state) and secondary valency (non-ionizable, coordination number, directional). IUPAC: cation first, ligands alphabetically, metal + (oxidation state).

stops.title: EAN rule & Isomerism in complexes
stops.inShort: EAN = Z − X + Y (Z = atomic no., X = electrons lost to form ion, Y = electrons donated by ligands = 2 × CN). Ionization isomers give different ions in solution (e.g. [Co(NH₃)₅Br]SO₄ and [Co(NH₃)₅SO₄]Br).

stops.title: Valence Bond Theory (VBT) & Crystal Field Theory (CFT)
stops.inShort: [Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺: d²sp³ (inner orbital octahedral, diamagnetic). [Ni(CN)₄]²⁻: dsp² (square planar, 0 unpaired e⁻, diamagnetic). [NiCl₄]²⁻: sp³ (tetrahedral, 2 unpaired e⁻, paramagnetic).

items.s: Z = atomic no., X = oxidation state, Y = 2 × CN.

board.text: When excess of AgNO₃ is added to a complex, one mole of AgCl is precipitated. The formula of complex is ____.
board.answer: (a) [CoCl₂(NH₃)₄]Cl (has 1 ionizable Cl⁻ outside the coordination sphere).

board.text: Write the number of donor atoms present in EDTA during formation of complex.
board.answer: 6 donor atoms (hexadentate ligand: 2 nitrogen atoms and 4 oxygen atoms).

board.text: (a) Write the formula to calculate EAN. (b) Explain formation of [Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺ complex ion with respect to: (i) Type of hybridisation (ii) Magnetic property.
board.answer:
(a) EAN = Z − X + Y (where Z = atomic number, X = oxidation state of metal, Y = electrons donated by ligands).
(b) For [Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺, Co³⁺ is 3d⁶. Strong field NH₃ pairs up the 3d electrons leaving two 3d orbitals empty:
(i) Hybridisation: d²sp³ (inner orbital octahedral).
(ii) Magnetic property: Diamagnetic (zero unpaired electrons).

board.text: The correct structure of complex having IUPAC name sodium hexanitrocobaltate(III) is ____.
Calculate effective atomic number of [Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺ ion.
Write postulates of Werner theory of co-ordination complexes. Write the name of a hexadentate ligand.
board.answer:
Postulates: (1) Metal shows two types of valencies: primary (ionizable, satisfied by negative ions) and secondary (non-ionizable, fixed CN, satisfied by neutral/negative ligands). (2) Secondary valencies are directed in space giving definite geometry.
Hexadentate ligand: Ethylenediaminetetraacetate ion (EDTA⁴⁻).
